0fac36f2-b1f2-4ce3-b88d-3eb1f9947d55/tex: Fashion is always of the time in which you live. It is not something standing alone. But the grand problem, the most important problem, is to rejeuvenate women. To make women look young. Then their outlook changes. They feel more joyous. It's a philosophy of life. A practice. If you do this, something will change, what will change is that you will change, your life will change, and if you can change you, you can perhaps change the world.
707ed860-2b0e-410b-a893-7cc886b0fbbb/tex: I've always thought of the T-shirt as the Alpha and Omega of the fashion alphabet. I would like to be a one-man multinational fashion phenomenon. Never in my wildest dreams did I entertain the idea that I would become a fashion designer. I truly believe that philanthropy and commerce can work together. Fashion never stops. There is always the new project, the new opportunity.
ce6aa447-7096-460f-9943-11c806c7d0bb/tex: I try as much as possible to give you a great basic product and what comes out, I feel, is really amazing. Grunge is a hippied romantic version of punk. Age and size are only numbers. It's the attitude you bring to clothes that make the difference. I sometimes feel that a pattern is almost a fashion statement in itself. I try as much as possible to give you a great basic product and what comes out, I feel, is really amazing.
